summary: The SiteRecruitmentOpportunities document is part of the HSPnet system, focusing on managing and displaying site recruitment opportunities. It includes web controls for handling data binding, command execution, and profile views.
purpose: To manage and display recruitment opportunities at various sites within the HSPnet system, facilitating user interaction through a web interface.

workflows.name: HandleAdd
steps: Bind the profile control to data
Show profile details in a modal

workflows.name: fvwProfile_ItemCommand
steps: Get HeadingID, SortOrder, and Response from form
Add or update SiteOpportunity based on ID
Hide details and redirect unless cancelled

business_rules: Do not repeat the header on subsequent rows for the same header
Display 'no data found' button if no rows and screen is editable
validations: Ensure SortOrder is not empty; default to '-1'
conditions: If SiteOpportunity is a webpage, use hyperlink for response
If no data found and screen is editable, show empty data panel
system_behavior: Control visibility of web controls based on data
exceptions: JavaScript errors related to event validation in grid view
